title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.26 - a co-op crash fix. Loading a saved co-op run - the way you come back after everyone has disconnected - made the meter throw on every frame and flood the log, because it was still holding the class icons it had resolved back at the main menu, and loading a run frees them. It now looks the icon up fresh each time, so the rows draw and the run loads normally. Solo runs were never affected. A saved breakdown that has been damaged now also costs you that breakdown rather than the run it belongs to. Verified against game v0.111.0; still works on v0.107.1 and later.
